name: pulse-monorepo
description: Pulse: a compile-to-DOM signals UI framework (monorepo).

scripts.build: bun run build:pulse && bun run build:docs && bun run build:examples
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/pulse typecheck && tsc -p apps/docs/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/counter/tsconfig.json
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/pulse/dist apps/docs/dist apps/docs/.pulse examples/*/dist examples/*/.pulse
